body: Buzz transcribes and translates audio offline on your personal computer. Powered by OpenAI's Whisper.
plain_description: Buzz gives you accurate transcripts and translations from any audio or video — entirely offline on your own computer, no cloud fees or privacy worries. It handles recordings, YouTube links, and even live microphone input. The bottom line: get professional-quality transcripts powered by OpenAI's Whisper without sending your data anywhere.
technical_description: Buzz is a cross-platform desktop application for offline speech-to-text transcription and translation using OpenAI's Whisper model. It supports multiple Whisper backends (OpenAI Whisper, Whisper.cpp) with GPU acceleration via CUDA (NVIDIA), Apple Silicon, and Vulkan (most GPUs including integrated). The application provides a Qt-based graphical interface and a command-line interface. Capabilities include file transcription (audio, video, YouTube links), real-time microphone capture with a presentation view, speaker identification, speech separation, watch-folder automation, and export to TXT, SRT, and VTT. An extensible plugin system provides AI summary generation and automated transcript resizing.
title: Buzz

plain_description: Transcribe audio up to 4x faster while using less memory than OpenAI's Whisper. This reimplementation cuts compute costs and hardware requirements without sacrificing accuracy. It runs on CPU and NVIDIA GPU, supports int8 quantization for further efficiency, and integrates with a broad ecosystem of speech tools.
technical_description: faster-whisper is a Python library that reimplements OpenAI's Whisper speech-to-text model using the CTranslate2 inference engine. It provides a programmatic API for transcribing audio with configurable model sizes (e.g. large-v3, distil-large-v3), beam search, word-level timestamps, and batched inference. GPU acceleration uses CUDA 12 with fp16 or int8 precision; CPU execution supports int8 quantization. Audio is decoded via PyAV (bundled FFmpeg). Optional Silero VAD filters non-speech segments. Models are automatically downloaded from Hugging Face Hub or loaded from local directories.
title: Faster Whisper

body: A scalable generative AI framework built for researchers and developers working on Large Language Models, Multimodal, and Speech AI (Automatic Speech Recognition and Text-to-Speech)
plain_description: NVIDIA NeMo Speech lets you build, customize, and deploy speech AI models — ASR, TTS, and Speech LLMs — using pre-trained checkpoints and existing code. The big picture: researchers and developers can go from idea to production faster without reinventing the wheel. Here's why it matters: you get NVIDIA-optimized performance on GPU infrastructure with Docker or pip install.
technical_description: NVIDIA NeMo Speech is a PyTorch-based framework for building, fine-tuning, and deploying speech AI models including Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), Text-to-Speech (TTS), and Speech LLMs. It provides pre-trained model checkpoints, modular model collections (ASR, TTS, audio, speechlm2), and inference pipelines with streaming support. The framework installs via pip (nemo-toolkit[asr,tts]) or Docker, requires Python ≥3.12 and PyTorch ≥2.7, and depends on NVIDIA GPU + CUDA for training. It includes tools for dataset processing, forced alignment, speech data exploration, and voice agent construction using the Pipecat framework.
title: NVIDIA NeMo Speech

body: Silero VAD: pre-trained enterprise-grade Voice Activity Detector
plain_description: Silero VAD reliably detects when a person is speaking in any audio stream or recording — a critical building block for voice bots, call center automation, and voice-enabled products. It works across 6,000+ languages and runs efficiently on standard CPUs with no cloud dependency, no API keys, and no recurring fees. The bottom line: add accurate voice activity detection to your product in minutes with zero vendor lock-in.
technical_description: Silero VAD is a pre-trained Voice Activity Detection (VAD) model that identifies speech segments in audio streams. It is implemented in PyTorch and also distributed as an ONNX model with safetensors weights, supporting CPU inference using AVX instructions and optional GPU acceleration via CUDA. The JIT model footprint is approximately 2 MB and processes 30 ms audio chunks in under 1 ms on a single CPU thread. Integration is available via pip (silero-vad), torch.hub, or ONNX Runtime, with community examples in C++, Rust, Go, Java, C#, and browser JavaScript using ONNX Runtime Web.
title: Silero VAD

plain_description: SpeechBrain accelerates building conversational AI — speech assistants, chatbots, and voice interfaces — with a single open-source toolkit. Instead of juggling separate tools for speech recognition, text-to-speech, and language understanding, you get 200+ ready-made training recipes and 100+ pretrained models out of the box. The result: faster prototyping and shorter time-to-market for voice-enabled products.
technical_description: SpeechBrain is an open-source PyTorch toolkit for conversational AI development. It provides a modular training framework based on the Brain class, with YAML-driven hyperparameter configuration and dynamic batching for variable-length audio. The toolkit ships 200+ training recipes across 40+ datasets covering speech recognition, speaker recognition, speech enhancement, speech separation, text-to-speech, translation, language modeling, and more. Pretrained models are distributed through HuggingFace with a three-line Python inference API. The framework supports single and multi-GPU training, mixed precision, distributed training, and scalable data loading via WebDataset for large datasets on shared filesystems.
title: SpeechBrain

body: Offline speech recognition API for Android, iOS, Raspberry Pi and servers with Python, Java, C# and Node
plain_description: Vosk gives you accurate offline speech recognition across 20+ languages, right on your device — no cloud dependency required. Models are tiny (50 MB) yet deliver real-time transcription, speaker identification, and customizable vocabulary. Works on Android, iOS, Raspberry Pi, and servers.
technical_description: Vosk is an offline, open-source speech recognition toolkit providing real-time transcription via a streaming API with zero-latency response. It ships pre-trained acoustic models (~50 MB per language) covering 20+ languages with continuous large-vocabulary recognition. The toolkit exposes native bindings for Python, Java, Node.js, C#, C++, Rust, and Go, with platform support spanning Android, iOS, Linux, macOS, and Windows on ARM and x86 architectures. It includes speaker identification, reconfigurable vocabulary, and scales from edge devices to server clusters.
title: Vosk Speech Recognition Toolkit

body: Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision
plain_description: Whisper turns spoken audio into accurate text across nearly 100 languages — no complex pipeline needed. A single model handles transcription, translation, and language detection, replacing multi-vendor stacks with one open-source solution. The bottom line: production-grade speech recognition that runs on your own infrastructure after a single install.
technical_description: Whisper is a Transformer sequence-to-sequence model for general-purpose speech processing, trained via large-scale weak supervision. It performs multilingual speech recognition, speech translation, language identification, and voice activity detection using a single architecture with task-specific decoder tokens. The Python package provides CLI and programmatic API access to pre-trained PyTorch checkpoints ranging from 39M to 1.55B parameters. Audio is processed in 30-second sliding windows with autoregressive decoding. Model sizes span tiny (~1 GB VRAM, ~10x speed) to large (~10 GB VRAM), including an optimized turbo variant. Requires Python 3.8+, PyTorch, and ffmpeg.
title: Whisper

body: Port of OpenAI's Whisper model in C/C++
plain_description: The big picture: Turn speech into text on any device without sending audio to the cloud. Run entirely offline on phones, laptops, or servers — no internet needed, no per-minute API costs. Works everywhere from Raspberry Pis to data center GPUs, with a single portable C/C++ implementation.
technical_description: High-performance inference engine for OpenAI's Whisper ASR model implemented in plain C/C++ with zero runtime dependencies. The core library provides a stable C-style API for model loading, transcription, and translation, backed by the ggml tensor library. Supports CPU (ARM NEON, x86 AVX, POWER VSX), GPU (NVIDIA CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan), and NPU (Ascend CANN, OpenVINO) backends with automatic backend selection. Features include mixed F16/F32 precision, integer quantization, Core ML and OpenVINO encoder acceleration, voice activity detection via Silero-VAD, and an HTTP server with OpenAI-compatible API. Ships as a library with CLI tools, WebAssembly builds, and bindings for Rust, Go, Python, Java, Ruby, JavaScript, .NET, and Swift.
title: whisper.cpp

body: A Web UI for easy subtitle using whisper model.
plain_description: Whisper WebUI lets you generate accurate subtitles and transcriptions from audio and video files using AI — no technical expertise required. It supports multiple languages, identifies different speakers, and removes background noise for cleaner results. Run it locally, in Docker, or on Google Colab.
technical_description: Whisper WebUI is a Gradio-based browser interface for OpenAI's Whisper speech recognition model that provides subtitle generation from files, YouTube URLs, and microphone input. The application supports multiple Whisper inference backends — openai/whisper, faster-whisper (default), and insanely-fast-whisper — with faster-whisper providing reduced VRAM usage and improved transcription speed via CTranslate2. Audio pre-processing capabilities include Silero VAD for voice activity detection and UVR for background music separation. Post-processing supports speaker diarization via pyannote models. Text translation is available through Facebook NLLB models and DeepL API. Deployment options include Docker Compose, local Python environment, Pinokio, and Google Colab. A FastAPI-based REST API backend is available for service-oriented deployment.
title: Whisper WebUI

body: WhisperX:  Automatic Speech Recognition with Word-level Timestamps (& Diarization)
plain_description: WhisperX turns spoken audio into accurate, timestamped text faster than real time. It automatically identifies who said what with speaker labels, making it ideal for transcribing meetings, interviews, and podcasts. No manual editing needed for timing or speaker attribution.
technical_description: WhisperX is a Python library and CLI tool for automatic speech recognition (ASR) with word-level timestamps and speaker diarization. It builds on OpenAI's Whisper model using a faster-whisper CTranslate2 backend, achieving up to 70x realtime transcription on GPU. The pipeline employs wav2vec2.0-based forced phoneme alignment for accurate word-level timestamps and pyannote-audio for speaker diarization. It supports batched inference, voice activity detection (VAD) preprocessing, and runs on both NVIDIA GPU (CUDA) and CPU with configurable compute precision (float16, int8).
title: WhisperX
